popular.text: Half: Timberwolves 74, Nets 61 Brooklyn turned the ball over 12 times, leading to 18 points for Minnesota. The Timberwolves are 26/42 (62%) on FGs and 11/21 (52.4%) on threes. Mikel Brown Jr. has a team-high 17 points on 6/9 from the field and 4/5 from three for the Nets.

popular.text: This marks the fourth time in the Nets' last five games that they've allowed 70+ points in the first half. Their best first-half defensive performance during that span came vs. the Magic, when they allowed 62 points.
